tips: Load Suica to Apple/Google Wallet now while you have Wi-Fi at MSP — land in Tokyo ready to tap.
Set phones to JST mid-flight and take melatonin at 13:00 CT to jump-start the clock shift.

2026-12-15.weatherAlert: December evenings in Tokyo are dry but cold (often near 0°C). The Omoide Yokocho outdoor standing stalls will be freezing.
tips: Hit the ATM at Haneda or Shinjuku station right away; small ramen and yakitori stalls are cash-only.
If Ichiran has a long line, pivot to Shin-Okubo Koreatown one stop north for midnight Korean fried chicken.

2026-12-16.weatherAlert: High rain risk for an outdoor-heavy day. Meiji Shrine walk and Shibuya Blue Cave illumination are exposed.

suggestedSwap.suggestedAlt: Miyashita Park covered rooftop + Parco + Tower Records
suggestedSwap.reason: The Blue Cave is an outdoor walk along Yoyogi Park that is miserable in December rain; Miyashita Park offers covered shopping, dining, and a rooftop to kill the afternoon.

tips: Shibuya Sky sunset slots sell out fast; if it's raining, swap for Mag's Park rooftop or Shibuya Hikarie 11F Sky Lobby.
Book your nomihodai izakaya in advance — a group of 8 walking in on a Saturday night will be turned away.

2026-12-17.weatherAlert: Rain risk continues. Nakamise Street and Hoppy Street are uncovered and packed; rain makes them miserable.

suggestedSwap.reason: Hoppy Street is entirely outdoor standing bars; if it rains, pivot to the nearby Tokyo National Museum for 2 hours of world-class indoor culture.

tips: If the Skytree queue is insane, go next door to the Asahi Beer Hall's 22F Sky Room for the same river view with a beer.
Akihabara is overwhelming — split the squad: nerds hit Super Potato/Mandarake, others do Kanda Myojin shrine and reconvene.

2026-12-18.crowdAlert: teamLab Planets is extremely popular; even with pre-booked tickets, arrive 15 mins early to clear the queue.
tips: Golden Gai bars seat 6-8 max; your group of 8 will need to split across two bars or wait for a rare large one.
After Tsukiji, walk 10 min to Hama-rikyu Gardens for an Edo tidal garden digestif walk and island tea house.

2026-12-19.weatherAlert: High rain risk for a coastal day trip. The Enoshima climb and Fuji-over-the-bay sunset are weather-dependent.

suggestedSwap.originalActivity: Enoshima island — climb to the Sea Candle
suggestedSwap.suggestedAlt: Enoshima onsen finish: Enospa overlooks the bay
suggestedSwap.reason: If it's raining, climbing Enoshima is slippery and the Fuji view is zero; Enospa offers an indoor onsen soak with bay views to salvage the stop.

tips: December is peak clarity for Mt. Fuji; if it's a clear day, prioritize the 16:32 sunset spot over Sagami Bay.
The Enoden coastal tram is charming but slow; if running late, skip Komachi-dori and head straight to Kotoku-in.
Run the Airbnb washer during dinner so everyone lands in Kyoto with clean clothes.
If Golden Gai feels repetitive, pivot to Shinjuku Batting Center for $3 (¥500) midnight swings.
Grab ekiben at Tokyo Station's Ekibenya Matsuri before boarding — 200+ kinds, perfect for the Nozomi ride.
Pontocho Alley izakaya for 8 requires a reservation; confirm your booking to avoid wandering hungry.

2026-12-22.weatherAlert: Rain risk for the Fushimi Inari outdoor hike. The thousands of torii gates offer little shelter from steady rain.

suggestedSwap.reason: If it's pouring, hiking Fushimi Inari is slippery and photos are ruined; Sanjusangendo is indoor, jaw-dropping, and criminally underrated.

tips: If you do Fushimi Inari, go past Yotsutsuji — the crowds hit zero and you get a deserted mountain.
Funaoka Onsen's 1923 'electric bath' is wild; brace yourself and keep away from the walls.

2026-12-23.weatherAlert: Rain risk for Arashiyama Bamboo Grove and Nara deer park; both are fully outdoor with little shelter.

suggestedSwap.suggestedAlt: Kimono Forest at Randen Arashiyama station
suggestedSwap.reason: The hike up to the monkey park is steep and dangerous in December rain; the Kimono Forest is right at the station, free, and beautiful in the drizzle.

tips: Wakakusa-yama is closed for the winter (since Dec 13) — do NOT attempt the climb.
When feeding Nara deer, bow first, show empty hands when done, and never run.

2026-12-24.crowdAlert: KFC for Christmas dinner is a sacred Japanese tradition; reserve your bucket days in advance or face a 2-hour line.
tips: If you missed the Nintendo Museum lottery, Uji still delivers with Byodo-in, Tsuen tea, and matcha soba.
Buy a Rikuro's jiggly cheesecake near Namba station for the house — they do not survive the night.

2026-12-25.crowdAlert: USJ on Christmas Day will be at capacity; Express Passes are mandatory for a group of 8 to avoid 3-hour queues.
tips: If Super Nintendo World is sold out, use single-rider lines to cut 60% off Mario Kart wait times.
Non-USJ faction can hit Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan + Tempozan wheel for a full alternative Christmas 20 min away.

2026-12-26.weatherAlert: Rain risk for Miyajima. The floating torii gate is accessed via a short ferry and exposed waterfront walk.
tips: This is the longest day of the trip; anyone redlining should skip Miyajima, do the museum unhurried, and meet at Hiroshima station.
If the museum hits heavy (it will), walk 10 min to Shukkei-en garden for quiet reflection.

2026-12-27.weatherAlert: Rain risk for the 4km Midosuji Illumination walk. It's an outdoor boulevard walk that is miserable in heavy rain.

suggestedSwap.originalActivity: MIDOSUJI ILLUMINATION — 4km of lit boulevard, walked south
suggestedSwap.reason: If it's pouring, walking 4km of outdoor illuminated boulevard is miserable; the Museum of Housing & Living offers a life-size indoor Edo street experience.

tips: Buy 551 Horai butaman from Namba station BEFORE the crab dinner — they sell out nightly and house breakfast depends on it.
Misono Building has 40 micro-bars; scout it tonight to decide if it's the finale for Dec 28.
Do your tax-free paperwork check tonight: receipts with passports, purchases accessible — customs CAN ask on exit.
If Kobe beef lunch blows the budget, $22 (¥3,500) Kobe-beef bowls and croquette stands around Sannomiya deliver 70% of the experience.
Zero out your Suica cards and play the final boss gachapon at Haneda before security.
Buy Japanese whisky (Hibiki/Yamazaki) AFTER security at HND; do NOT bury it in a checked bag transfer at MSP.

globalTips: The USD/JPY rate is highly favorable (~161 JPY to 1 USD). Withdraw large sums from 7-Eleven ATMs to avoid per-transaction fees, but carry cash — many small ramen and yakitori stalls are cash-only.
December in Japan is cold, dry, but prone to occasional rain. Pack a warm, windproof outer layer and a compact umbrella; outdoor activities like Fushimi Inari and Enoshima are highly exposed.
For a group of 8, always make dinner reservations. Walk-ins at popular izakayas, shabu-shabu, and KFC on Christmas Eve will be turned away due to capacity limits.
